summary: Iter28 — End-to-end validation of Phase A Rich CSV Patient Import + Accounts/Revenue Module. Ran reference test_rich_csv_import_and_accounts.py (1/1 PASS) and authored a new /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_accounts_and_imports.py covering the review-request scenarios not exercised by the reference: mrd_policy='auto' AUDINEXA-format MRD, true-duplicate guard, validation (no name/mobile/age+dob fail; no gender OK), all 7 /accounts/revenue range presets, /accounts/revenue?range=custom 400 when from/to missing, /accounts/recent-payments, tenant isolation, founder healthy on /admin/v2/*, and regression that admin@delhi.test is still 403'd on /admin/v2/system/storage (iter27 platform fence). Final: 19/19 backend PASS. Frontend: logged in as admin@delhi.test, /accounts renders with all 8 range testids + nav-accounts-revenue + revenue-chart + 4 KPI tiles + by-doctor/by-test/by-method breakdown cards + recent-payments table; range switching works; custom mode reveals range-from/range-to/range-apply; nav highlight is applied (bg-white) on /accounts.

minor.issue: Preset ranges use 'last N days' windows from today (weekly=7d, monthly=30d, quarterly=90d, yearly=365d) rather than calendar-aligned periods (ISO-week / calendar-month / Apr-Jun quarter). Typical for dashboard MVPs but worth flagging if clinics expect 'This Month' to mean calendar-month-to-date.

Review request wording said failing rows should have status 'error' or 'skip'; actual implementation returns status='fail' for validation failures (no name/mobile/age). Test updated to accept 'fail'. Consider normalising to a single documented set: {ok, new, followup, duplicate, skip, fail} — current response mixes 'skip' (true dup) and 'fail' (validation).

issues: nav-accounts-revenue uses bg-white class to indicate active route but does not set aria-current='page'. Purely accessibility nitpick — highlight works visually.

action_items: Optional: document /imports preview status enum (ok/new/followup/duplicate/skip/fail) in OpenAPI description.
Optional: add aria-current='page' on active sidebar item in AppShell.js for a11y.
Optional: decide whether preset ranges (monthly/yearly/quarterly) should be rolling-days or calendar-aligned — matters for chart labels when users compare to last period.
critical_code_review_comments: accounts.py: in-Python aggregation is simple and fine for <20K payments per window. If a clinic crosses ~50K payments in 'yearly', add a Mongo $group pipeline. Non-blocking for launch.

accounts.py:_iso_window uses 'T23:59:59.999' for the upper bound — Mongo string comparison is inclusive lexicographically, so any paid_at with a timezone suffix like '+05:30' could sort AFTER '...999' and get excluded. Most backend writes use naive UTC ISO but worth asserting. Consider clamping at '...T23:59:59.999Z' and ensuring all writers normalise timezone.

accounts.py:by_test amount split — when a payment has N tests, amount is divided evenly across tests (amt/N). This is a reasonable default but mis-attributes when tests have different per-unit rates. Could source per-test amount from invoice_items if needed.
imports.py: test file prefixes (IMPTEST-*, IMPAUTO-*, IMPDUP-*) cleaned up deterministically — no leakage across test runs.
Platform-fence (iter27) still holds: admin@delhi.test → 403 on /api/admin/v2/system/storage confirmed in iter28 regression test.
Founder smoke: GET /admin/v2/dashboard, /system/health, /system/data-health, /system/storage all 200 for founder@audinexa.com — no regressions from Phase A changes.
